<p>整理电脑的时候，翻出来一篇不知道是猴年马月写的文章，关于STL的简单介绍，应该是以前写给学生看的吧，贴在这里分享一下。</p> <h1 style="margin: 17pt 0in 16.5pt 0.3in;"><span><span>1<span style="font: 7pt 'Times New Roman';">       </span></span></span>STL<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">简介</span></h1> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0in 0in 0pt;">STL<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">是</span>Standard Template Library<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">的缩写，是</span>C++<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">标准库中最强大、最复杂、最有用的部分。</span>STL<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">主要由容器（</span>container<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">）、跌代子（</span>iterator<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">）、算法（</span>algorithm<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">）所组成。</span></p> <h2 style="margin: 13pt 0in 13pt 0.4in;"><span><span><font face="Arial">1.1</font><span style="font: 7pt 'Times New Roman';">    </span></span></span><span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simhei;">容器</span></h2> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0in 0in 0pt;"><span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">容器是存放和管理数据元素的数据结构，容器分为两大类：顺序容器（</span>sequence container<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">）和关联容器（</span>associative container<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">）。</span></p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0in 0in 0pt;"><span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">顺序容器有：</span>vector, deque, list</p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0in 0in 0pt;"><span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">关联容器有：</span>map, set, multi_map, multi_set</p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0in 0in 0pt;"><span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">特殊的容器：</span>string, array</p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0in 0in 0pt;"><span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">容器适配器：</span>stack, queue, priority_queue</p> <h2 style="margin: 13pt 0in 13pt 0.4in;"><span><span><font face="Arial">1.2</font><span style="font: 7pt 'Times New Roman';">    </span></span></span><span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simhei;">跌代子</span></h2> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0in 0in 0pt;"><span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">跌代子是用来访问容器内元素的对象，类似指针。</span></p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0in 0in 0pt;"><span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">跌代子分为：随机跌代子，双向跌代子，单向跌代子，输入跌代子，输出跌代子</span></p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0in 0in 0pt;"><span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">跌代子适配器</span></p> <h2 style="margin: 13pt 0in 13pt 0.4in;"><span><span><font face="Arial">1.3</font><span style="font: 7pt 'Times New Roman';">    </span></span></span><span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simhei;">算法</span></h2> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0in 0in 0pt;"><span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">算法是用来处理容器内的元素的一些操作，比如搜索、排序、拷贝、修改等。</span></p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0in 0in 0pt;"><span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">算法分为两大类：更易型和非更易型</span></p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0in 0in 0pt;"><span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">迭代子</span></h1> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0in 0in 0pt;"><span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">迭代子是一种能够遍历容器里面的全部或者部分元素的对象，一个迭代子能够表示容器里面一个特定的位置。</span></p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0in 0in 0pt;"><span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">使用</span>begin(), end()<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">获得容器的迭代子。迭代子的类型会随着容器的不同而不同，可表示为</span>container&lt;T&gt;::iterator,<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">如果支持双向跌代，则可以通过</span>rbegin(), rend()<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">获得反向跌代子。反向跌代子的类型为：</span>container&lt;T&gt;::reverse_iterator, </p> <h2 style="margin: 13pt 0in 13pt 0.4in;"><span><span><font face="Arial">6.1</font><span style="font: 7pt 'Times New Roman';">    </span></span></span><font face="Arial">Categories</font></h2> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0in 0in 0pt;">Input<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">：只能单向读取，比如</span>istream</p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0in 0in 0pt;">Output<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">：只能单向写入，比如</span>ostream</p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0in 0in 0pt;">Forward<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">：单向读取和写入，具有</span>Input<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">和</span>Output<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">跌代子的全部能力，比如</span>slist</p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0in 0in 0pt;">Bidirectional<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">：双向读取和写入，具有</span>Forward<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">跌代子的全部能力，比如</span>list, set, map</p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0in 0in 0pt;">Random<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">：随机读取和写入，具有</span>Bidirectional<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">跌代子的全部能力，比如</span>vector, deque</p> <h2 style="margin: 13pt 0in 13pt 0.4in;"><span><span><font face="Arial">6.2</font><span style="font: 7pt 'Times New Roman';">    </span></span></span><font face="Arial">operators</font></h2> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0in 0in 0pt;"><span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">迭代子最基本的操作有：</span></p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0in 0in 0pt;">iter++, ++iter<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">：让跌代子移动到下一个元素，有前置后置两种形式。</span></p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0in 0in 0pt;">*iter<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">：返回迭代子当前位置上的元素。如果是</span>Input<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">代子，返回元素的值，只能读取；如果是</span>Output<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">跌代子，返回引用，只能写入。</span></p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0in 0in 0pt;">iter1 == iter2 , iter1 != iter2<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">：判断两个跌代子是否指向同一个位置。（</span>Output<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">没有此操作）</span></p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0in 0in 0pt;">iter1 = iter2<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">：改变跌代子指向的位置。（</span>Output<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">没有此操作）</span></p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0in 0in 0pt;">iter -&gt;<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">：如果元素是类（结构体），则可以使用</span>-&gt;<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">直接访问元素的成员。</span></p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0in 0in 0pt;">iter --, --iter<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">：使用</span>--<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">移动到前一个元素，有前置后置两种形式。（双向跌代子和随机跌代子）</span></p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0in 0in 0pt;">iter [n]<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">：后面第</span>n<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">个的元素（</span>Random<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">跌代子）</span></p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0in 0in 0pt;">iter += n<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">：往后面移动</span>n<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">个位置（</span>Random<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">跌代子）</span></p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0in 0in 0pt;">iter -= n<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">：往前面移动</span>n<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">个位置（</span>Random<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">跌代子）</span></p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0in 0in 0pt;">iter + n, n + iter<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">：后面第</span>n<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">个位置（</span>Random<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">跌代子）</span></p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0in 0in 0pt;">iter - n<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">：前面第</span>n<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">个位置（</span>Random<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">跌代子）</span></p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0in 0in 0pt;">iter1 - iter2: <span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">两个元素之间的距离（</span>Random<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">跌代子）</span></p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0in 0in 0pt;">iter1&lt;iter2, iter1 &gt; iter2, iter1 &lt;= iter2, iter1 &gt;= iter2: <span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">比较两个跌代子的位置（</span>Random<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">跌代子）</span></p> <h2 style="margin: 13pt 0in 13pt 0.4in;"><span><span><font face="Arial">6.3</font><span style="font: 7pt 'Times New Roman';">    </span></span></span><font face="Arial">Auxiliary Iterator Functions</font></h2> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0in 0in 0pt;">advance(iter, n)<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">：将跌代子后移</span>n<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">个位置</span></p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0in 0in 0pt;">distance(iter1, iter2)<span lang="ZH-CN" style="font-family: simsun;">：两个跌代子之间的距离</span></p> <h2 style="margin: 13pt 0in 13pt 0.4in;"><span><span><font
